title: Accounts of Creation
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 7 Christian Religious Education; not yet checked by a CRE teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The learner narrates the two creation accounts (Genesis 1:1-2:4a: six days by God's word, people last, in God's image, rest on the seventh day; Genesis 2:4b-25: man from dust, the garden, animals named, woman from the rib), compares them, and identifies attributes of God (creator, all-powerful, orderly, good, caring).

floor.prerequisite: Knows God rested on the seventh day.
floor.question: Why did God rest on the seventh day?

steps: Name attributes of God the accounts show.
contexts: a sunrise over the Rift Valley
naming animals at a game park

board.do: Draw two columns: Genesis 1 and Genesis 2.
Point at the detail "man formed from dust".
Wait for the learner to say Genesis 2.

misconceptions.ask: In how many days did God create in Genesis 1, before resting?
misconceptions.repair: Number Genesis 1 day by day on the board; stop at day six; write "rest" on day seven.

misconceptions.ask: In which account is man formed from the dust?
misconceptions.repair: Make two columns, Genesis 1 and Genesis 2, and write where each detail comes from.

misconceptions.ask: Which attribute of God is shown in Genesis 1 by "God said... and it was so"?
misconceptions.repair: For each attribute, ask for the verse in Genesis 1-2 that shows it.

misconceptions.ask: In Genesis 1, on which day were human beings made?
misconceptions.repair: Write Genesis 1 in six boxes and Genesis 2 as a separate story; note the difference as one of the points to discuss.

checks.question: In Genesis 1, on which day were people made?
Name one attribute of God shown in creation.
